Hymn 304: Teach Me to Walk in the Light
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Clara W. McMaster
Lyricist/Text Author: Clara W. McMaster
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 304 titled "Teach Me to Walk in the Light" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Clara W. McMaster and the lyrics were written by Clara W. McMaster.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
